column1: # CHAOS-13520: the unit-test packages too long for one five-minute go-quality test leg run as PARTS parts of their test names.
# Format: package<TAB>parts (parts >= 2), sorted by package (C locale). ci/go_race_shard.awk places each part like a package, at
# the weight its test rows give it (ci/go_test_split_weights.tsv, CHAOS-13668); check_go.sh lists the package's names with
# `go test -list` (the leg's own build) and cuts them by those rows (a measured name longest first onto the lightest part, any
# other name by a hash of its name), then runs a part's names through -run beside the shard's other packages (a package with
# race-excluded rows runs fresh with -json, so the shard reads its rows' receipts from that run). A new test joins a part with no
# edit and moves no other test. A split package needs at least `parts` test rows. It is never pinned (ci/go_test_pins.tsv) or solo.
# parts = ceil(measured seconds / 150), the measured time from the test legs of run 42838102780 (PR #6046, ae06059f).
# CHAOS-13520 (acp, after PR #6058 run at d4b3b08c): internal/cigates/chartgates 4 -> 6 parts (958 s), internal/cigates/splitshards split in 4 parts (1166 s).
